core_obligations: Truncate: use the truncation triangle and the finite injective dimension of the second complex to show that the cohomology of the internal hom from the tail vanishes above a bound depending on the truncation (proof lines 2797-2805)
Compare: consequently each Ext group of the original pair agrees with the corresponding one of the truncated pair, for a sufficiently negative truncation (proof lines 2806-2808)

Finiteness: the cited statement applies to the truncated complex, which is bounded above and coherent, so each Ext group is a finite module and the internal hom lies in the bounded coherent category (proof lines 2809-2814)
proof_roadmap: 取截断三角 τ_{≤n}K → K → τ_{≥n+1}K → …；由 L 有限内射维数，RHom_A(τ_{≥n+1}K, L) 在 ≥ c − n 次以上消失。
于是对固定的 i，取 n 足够负，Ext^i_A(K, L) → Ext^i_A(τ_{≤n}K, L) 是同构。
对 τ_{≤n}K 与 L 用跨章引理，得各 Ext^i 是有限 A-模 ⇒ RHom_A(K, L) ∈ D_Coh(A)。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the internal hom of two bounded coherent complexes over a Noetherian ring, the second of finite injective dimension, again has finite cohomology modules (author lemma at source lines 2790-2795, label lemma-finite-ext-into-bounded-injective). The proof (source lines 2797-2815) uses a truncation triangle to replace the first complex by a bounded-above piece, shows the Ext groups agree for a sufficiently negative truncation and concludes finiteness from the cited statement (proof lines 2797-2814). The truncation comparison is the substance. H3.
